title: Reset Your Sleep: CBT-I Program
summary: A six-week CBT-I protocol for improving sleep efficiency, reducing wake time, and lowering sleep-related anxiety through behavioral methods.

modules.title: Sleep Baseline and Pattern Mapping
modules.overview: Track timing, awakenings, and daytime function to establish your baseline and target improvements.
takeaways: Sleep quality depends on consistency, not only total time in bed.
exercises: Identify top two habits that destabilize sleep.
homework: Track sleep daily for seven days.
Write a one-paragraph goal for sleep consistency.

modules.title: Stimulus Control
modules.overview: Rebuild the bed-sleep association and reduce wakeful rumination in bed.
takeaways: The bed should cue sleep, not alertness.
Leaving bed during prolonged wakefulness can retrain sleep response.
exercises: Practice leave-bed-return protocol when awake more than 20 minutes.
homework: Apply stimulus control rules every night this week.
Record adherence and impact in the sleep diary.

modules.title: Sleep Routine Hardening
modules.overview: Turn your evening and morning routines into stable sleep anchors.

aiSupport.systemPrompt: Guide the user through CBT-I routines, reinforce consistency, and avoid diagnostic claims.
